self.text: Hey there! I'm Bay, a 40‑something from Japan who loves late‑night skies and stargazing with a telescope in my backyard. I’m not into coaching or teaching anyone, just playing the game as it is and enjoying the flow of the match. If you share the same love for intense, skill‑based play and prefer to keep things text‑focused, we’ll get along great. Looking forward to some exciting matches and maybe swapping astronomy stories over a cup of coffee!
